limitations: The three-hop planner bound is a proposed safety/complexity bound, not a deployed-router limit.
Route ranking is deterministic policy over comparable fresh candidates; it is not a trading recommendation or price oracle.
A candidate remains unusable if any required pool read, provider response, deployment coordinate, user bound, or exact simulation is missing.

records.hopEncoding: ABI array of (address from,address to,bool stable,address factory)
rules: Require one through three contiguous hops; route[i].to must equal route[i+1].from.
Preserve stable and volatile pool identity per hop.
Treat factory zero only as the deployed router's defaultFactory sentinel; otherwise require current factoryRegistry approval.
Reject the entire route if any pool is absent/unrecognized or any required quote item fails; never accept a zero-filled partial amount array.

records.hopEncoding: exact-input packed bytes: tokenIn(20) || int24 tickSpacing(3) || tokenOut(20), then repeat tickSpacing || tokenOut
rules: Encode tick spacing as a three-byte signed two's-complement integer and preserve the exact-input token order.
Require an enabled tick spacing and a current recognized pool for every hop.
Use exactInputSingle only for one hop and exactInput for two or three hops.
Do not reverse the path; reversal is an exact-output convention and exact-output remains disabled.
The basic and CL routers are separate destinations with incompatible route encodings and payer/custody behavior.
Do not compile a basic+CL candidate as one transaction without an evidenced deployed composer and reviewed command semantics.
A sequential plan is multiple independently bounded transactions; re-quote and re-simulate after each confirmed/reconciled leg.
No official current Mezo Universal Router address or command-byte ABI was established.
Do not infer upstream command numbers, Permit2 semantics, balance flags, recipient sentinels, or protocol-family support.
Unknown provider, route family, command, or entrypoint fails closed.

preconditions: explicit user maximum age and slippage
order: stable provider ID as final deterministic tie-break
ranking.partialFailure: Keep optional provider errors as typed diagnostics, but fail the workflow if no eligible candidate remains or a selected candidate lacks any required observation.
ranking.noGuarantee: Estimated or quoted amountOut is ranking data. Only the caller-authorized amountOutMinimum is an execution bound, and even it requires exact-call simulation and reconciliation.
